newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Schindler H1 core orders down 4.7 pct. [CORRECTED 16:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Schindler H1 core orders down 4.7 pct. [CORRECTED 16:40 GMT]

text.p: Swiss elevator and escalator maker Schindler Holding AG said its core business order intake during the first six months of 1996 was down 4.7 percent as compared to the same period last year.

The company said in its letter to shareholders that orders for elevators and escalators fell 4.7 percent to 2.106 billion francs from 2.210 billion. Total group orders were down by 2.5 perent to 2.38 billion.

However, group orders were 7.7 percent higher at 2.63 billion as of July 2, following an 247 million (corrects from 878 million) franc tilting train order from the Swiss Federal Railway. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
